sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Visual, Tactile) Lightning Release, Clash

system.description:
The ultimate jutsu of the Genwa Clan, culminating in the control, abstraction, solidification and release of Data in its most destructive form. You stick your hands out in front of you collecting as much data release energy in front of you filled with useless information and pointless data noise, forming a large sphere of energy, before you release it into a destructive wave of neon light, that shreds everything in its way.

All creatures in this jutsu’s range must make a Dexterity saving throw.

Success: Affected creature takes half of 5d12 lightning damage and are Shocked until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creature takes 5d12 lightning damage are Shocked, Firewalled, Blinded and Deafened for the next minute. Affected creature rolls 1d4, at the end of their turns, determining the saving throw to make. On a success, they select one condition to end, having to remove each one individually. (1: Constitution, 2: Intelligence, 3: Wisdom, 4: Charisma)

Critical Failure: Affected creature takes 6d12 lightning damage are Shocked, Firewalled, Blinded and Deafened for the next minute. At the end of their turns, you can select one of the 4 listed stats forcing them to make the associated saving throw. On a success, they select one condition to end, having to remove each one individually. (1: Constitution, 2: Intelligence, 3: Wisdom, 4: Charisma).

Angel Link: This jutsu cannot affect allied creatures.

Demon Link: Creatures that fail their saving throws have any jutsu they are concentrating on dispelled.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d12.
